{{Quote|You think he’s working for the Empire?|Unidentified Rebel chief tech about Nuso Esva|<ref name="COO" />}}
This '''chief tech''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was part of the Rebel force sent to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] during a [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]]<ref name="COO" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> When [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Eastern Fleet]] arrived in the system, the chief technician wondered whether Esva was aligning himself with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="COO" />
